episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Putting their trust on the line, a couple considers a proposal from a notorious investor: a night with Sean in exchange for funding Lisa's startup.

episodes.title: What Now
episodes.summary: Life speeds up and threatens to spin out of control as Emigen's big news gets out, Sean faces the past, and Lisa confronts Anne, who dares her to waver.

episodes.title: What Happened
episodes.summary: Secrets and lies threaten the ties that bind a shattered Lisa and anguished Sean. Angela and Marcos are torn by desire, and Anne revisits old haunts.

episodes.title: What Drama
episodes.summary: Trying to pick up the pieces, Sean steps up and Angela looks for answers. Anne sets the stage for ruin while couples assemble for real estate drama.

episodes.title: What Next
episodes.summary: A month later, Lisa makes key discoveries and Sean gets big news. The past catches up to a confident Anne, cornered Angela and guilt-ridden Marcos.

episodes.title: What History
episodes.summary: Lisa leverages the limelight and helps Cassidy delve into Anne's history. Secrets come to light for Sean and Marcos while Ian goes to new extremes.

episodes.title: What Ghosts
episodes.summary: A dark and stormy flight brings Lisa and Anne together. The walls close in on Sean at his reunion, and Todd reconnects with an old nemesis.

episodes.title: What Secrets
episodes.summary: The shadows threaten to swallow up all certainty as Sean shuts out Lisa, and Marcos tells the truth. Angela and Todd dig into Ian's murky origins.

episodes.title: WTF
episodes.summary: In a gambit for control, Lisa tries to turn the tables on her tormentors. Cracks appear in Anne's cynical facade, and Ian plays a sick game of house.

episodes.title: What Remains
episodes.summary: The truth will come out. Lisa makes big moves against major players, Sean heads to court, and Angela deals with a life-and-death decision.
